Regions exactly partition the15000mm\u00b2 frame. One vertical divider and one right-only horizontal divider meet at an intendedTjunction; no horizontal divider through green band. Internal2/5fraction and top/bottom colour roles supported by primary presidency/law indexed text. Direct presidency reader returned no body lines; no primary flag image inspected.
